about: The sound lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): 5 new sounds in a brief's words (fewer than the visual lanes: sound has 2 verdicts and 3 sets; the count is stated in every eval), keywords = what a session would type into today's library search. Written before any method was run on them; labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json). Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: shotgun blast: a sharp transient crack, a heavy low boom, the pump racking after it, a short room tail
magic charge-up: a rising shimmering tone that swells, sparkles on top, ending in a bright release
footstep on wood: a heel thud and a creak of the plank, a light scuff
UI confirm: a short bright click with a soft chime on top
distant explosion: a deep rolling boom with a long tail, debris falling after it
